# glinet_wireguard_server_peer (Resource)

Manages a peer of the WireGuard server of the router: a client device that can connect (`wg-server.add_peer` in the router API). The router gives the peer its tunnel address and its keys. The resource does not give the configuration file of the client device; export it in the web UI. The resource does not initialize, start or stop the server. Create fails when the server is not initialized; initialize it in the web UI. Destroy removes the peer from the router. Import the peer with its ID, for example `terraform import glinet_wireguard_server_peer.example 1234`. The write of this resource was not tested on a router; the parameters come from the router's web UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key is made up. Keep real keys out of the configuration, for example in a sensitive variable.
resource "glinet_wireguard_server_peer" "phone" {
  name          = "phone"
  preshared_key = "FAKE+PEER+PRESHARED+KEY+DOCS+0000000000000A="
  allowed_ips   = ["0.0.0.0/0", "::/0"]
  dns           = ["192.168.8.1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the peer (`name` in the router API): 1 to 64 characters, not only spaces, without a `.` at the start and without `~`.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) 1 to 5 IP networks for the configuration of the client device, for example `["0.0.0.0/0"]` (`allowed_ips` in the router API, one string with `, ` between the items). When it is not set, the provider does not send it and keeps the value of the router. To remove a value from the router, replace the resource.
- `dns` (List of String) IP addresses of the DNS servers for the configuration of the client device (`dns` in the router API, one string with `, ` between the items). When it is not set, the provider does not send it and keeps the value of the router. To remove a value from the router, replace the resource.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the tunnel, from 576 to 65535 (`mtu` in the router API). When it is not set, the provider does not send it and keeps the value of the router. To remove a value from the router, replace the resource.
- `persistent_keepalive` (Number) Interval of the keepalive packets in seconds, from 1 to 65535 (`persistent_keepalive` in the router API). When it is not set, the provider does not send it and keeps the value of the router. To remove a value from the router, replace the resource.
- `preshared_key` (String, Sensitive) Preshared key, 44 characters of base64 (`presharedkey` in the router API). The provider sends `presharedkey_enable` `true` when it is set and `false` when it is not set.

### Read-Only

- `client_ip` (String) Address of the client device in the tunnel, which the router gives (`client_ip` in the router API).
- `id` (Number) ID of the peer, which the router gives (`peer_id` in the router API).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the peer ID.
terraform import glinet_wireguard_server_peer.phone 1234
```
